warnings: ALTERNATIVE roof system: A-05 lets the contractor choose either the hot-rolled steel roof (S-06, S-22, S-23) or this cold-formed prefab truss system (โครงหลังคาสำเร็จรูป, PT-01..PT-05). Both are recorded; a BOQ must use one of them, not both.

Trusses are grouped per printed number (count + area): their positions follow the printed spacing row 0.80 / 0.73 / 1.33 ... 1.33 / 0.73 / 0.80, whose 1.33 values are rounded thirds of the 4.00 bay that cannot be placed to the millimetre — so no 1/3-bay grid lines were created (the row is kept verbatim in the grid master unassigned list).

NOTE (printed, English): Ensure roof bracing is installed in accordance with the Truss-Supplier Installation Manual. Lateral restraints (TOPSPAN40 / Top Chord material) continuing over adjacent trusses at 1.8m intervals are to be provided and braced to the ceiling plane.
Section mark 2-2 cuts the plan near grid 9 (detail on PT-03).
